symptom: CE7054 "parameters updated" / CE7067 "does not support body entity" after `send rest request`
cause: `addSendRestRequestAction` emitted wrong BSON: all params as query params, BodyVariable set for JSON bodies
insight: Look up operation via `fb.restServices`; route path/query params with `buildRestParameterMappings`; suppress BodyVariable for JSON/TEMPLATE/FILE via `shouldSetBodyVariable`
